_doc: VALLEY REGION (chapters 1-2) — refinement of world.json's 'valley' envelope.
STORY GEOGRAPHY (user, 2026-07-30): the Whisperwood highland bowl (NW) is
sealed from the valley by the gatewall spur; Emberbrook sits against the wall
with ONE forest entrance; the Old Gate is the wall's only cut. The river runs
in a STEEP CANYON: the road descends a bench on the SW (right-bank) wall — the same side
as Dellhollow's Valley Gate — and the far (NE) wall is tall unclimbable cliff
topped by visible-but-unreachable forest (ch3 territory). No crossings CAN
exist; onward is downriver through Dellhollow. Deep forest is represented as
CANOPY MASS (continuous undulating treetop surface, WALKABLE-UNDER, veg_-prefixed),
not standalone tree copies — specimen trees only at edges, clearings, and the
road corridor. ONE canonical scene: ow-valley, updated in place (no new keys).

GATING PRINCIPLE (user, 2026-07-30): forests are always walkable encounter terrain (FF9 model) — Whisperwood is gated by STRONG ENEMIES, not geometry. Hard restriction comes ONLY from height-based geography (unclimbable walls, undescendable cliffs).

elevation._doc: highland bowl h~26 NW of the gatewall; the SW right-bank side is HIGH LAND (road 24->12, land 19->11) with the river cutting an ever-deeper canyon below; far NE wall rises to a comparable forested plateau.

plateau.note: the Whisperwood highland — unioned with the Emberbrook anchor disc

canyon._doc: asymmetric trench along the whole spine. benchSide SW = HIGH LAND: the road holds plateau height (clearance grows downstream as the river cuts deeper), comparable to the far NE wall top; Dellhollow is the slope descending off the high land into the gorge. farPlateau tops the unreachable NE side.

waterAccess.note: the Moorage: the ONLY bench-side descent to water

shelf._doc: the valley path is a NARROW LEDGE hard against a HIGH mountain wall on the player's right (away from the river): restricted first-act overworld, open world saved for later

pockets.note: a broad natural terrace mid-descent, filled with walkable forest

overrun._doc: the ridge continues past Dellhollow along the gorge rim and pinches out naturally — the ledge is terrain, not an A-to-B corridor

river._doc: Refined course of the reborn spine (source at the gatewall foot). Parent width profile 3->22.

road._doc: Whisperwood entrance -> Emberbrook -> Old Gate -> around the river's source -> the SW (right-bank) bench -> Valley Gate. Never crosses: upstream of the source there is no river.

portals.note: map-edge fiction entrance; not traversable in ch1-2
town entry — the ONE way in from the forest
the cut through the gatewall; the only forest->valley passage. Vesper's bottleneck.
the town model's clifftop Valley Gate; SW rim, right bank, the road's side

corridor.note: the road cuts a corridor through the canopy; Emberbrook sits in a cleared pocket

forests.note: DEEP forest: continuous canopy mass, WALKABLE beneath (encounter terrain — strong-enemy gated, not geometry-gated); specimen trees at edges/corridor; the road corridor is the safe path
atop the far (NE) canyon wall - unreachable because the CLIFF is unclimbable (height gating), the forest itself is ordinary walkable canopy
open right-bank woodland: standalone trees, walkable between
walkable-under canopy forest filling the pocket terrace; the road keeps its corridor through it

crossings._doc: NONE — and none possible: the canyon geometry enforces it. Dellhollow's dam crest is the only span of the river in the world so far.

landmarks.note: the Whisperwood waystone where the corridor breaks out onto the bench
the tar-dark boat at the Moorage water access

townAnchors.note: warm-lit clearing town against the gatewall; the Old Gate visible at its shoulder
canyon-straddling impression, mass on the RIGHT (SW) bank per the master; stepped clusters, weir flight, wheels; entry notch on the SW rim

zoneOverrides.note: the far canyon wall is crag regardless of slope thresholds
